policy: KJ Genesis Funder Key Utility Policy
ownershipRule: Eligibility follows the wallet that owns a valid KJ Genesis Funder Key at the applicable verification or snapshot time.
important: This draft records intended product utility. It is not an offer, contract, guarantee of return, or substitute for final legal terms.

stages.name: Proof-of-Concept Pilot
stages.purpose: Run the first Project KJ field pilot and prove the concept works.
stages.fundingMechanism: Up to 150 Genesis Funder Keys at a $100 target price before fees and taxes.

stages.name: Udon Thani Expansion
stages.purpose: Fund the planned expansion across Udon Thani.
stages.gate: Opens only after the proof-of-concept pilot reaches its published success criteria.

stages.name: Bangkok and Token-Launch Preparation
stages.purpose: Prepare the regulated token launch and Bangkok rollout.
stages.gate: Opens only after Udon Thani expansion milestones and required legal and regulatory approvals.

fundingPlan.important: Stages 2 and 3 are separate conditional raises. The Genesis NFT does not itself grant equity or represent a share of those financing rounds.

benefits.name: Funder Vault
benefits.rule: Display a dedicated founder slot and current utility state after live ERC-721 ownership verification.

benefits.name: Node yield multiplier eligibility
benefits.rule: Apply 1.5x to an eligible holder's active merchant-tier node yield after the node program and its terms are live.
exclusions: No yield accrues before node activation.
The NFT contract does not calculate or pay yield.
Anti-abuse, suspension, tax, and jurisdiction rules remain to be defined.

benefits.name: Zero KJ platform commission eligibility
benefits.rule: Charge 0% KJ commission on eligible inventory sales, campaign tools, and token-routing services while ownership and merchant eligibility are valid.
exclusions: Taxes, payment-processor, blockchain, logistics, insurance, and third-party fees are not KJ platform commission.
Merchant misconduct or prohibited activity may suspend program eligibility under published terms.

benefits.name: Merchant Mystery Box claim
benefits.rule: One free claim or guaranteed allocation per token ID, protected by an on-chain or auditable consumed-claim registry.

benefits.name: Merchant Mystery Box luck boost
benefits.rule: Use independently verifiable randomness with 2x configured odds for KJ Genesis or KJ Global and a guaranteed minimum of KJ Pioneer.
requirements: Publish the complete base and boosted probability tables before claims open.
Define how doubled top-tier weights are normalized.

benefits.name: First-wave IOTA hardware priority
benefits.rule: Give eligible holders priority access to pilot beacon or sensor development kits.
exclusions: Availability, destination, duties, identity checks, and shipping terms must be published before fulfillment.
Priority does not mean guaranteed delivery in every jurisdiction.

benefits.name: 5% founder pool eligibility
benefits.rule: Proposed collective pool equal to 5% of defined net Merchant Mystery Box mint receipts and defined net node-upgrade fees.
requirements: Define gross versus net receipts, currencies, refunds, taxes, chargebacks, payment fees, and accounting periods.
Define snapshot timing, transferred-token treatment, sanctions and KYC requirements, minimum payout, dust, unclaimed funds, and program duration.
Publish auditable statements and a payout claim process.
Obtain required legal and regulatory approvals before activation.
benefits.important: The ERC-721 token alone does not create or automatically distribute this right.
